points: 50% say data protection hinders AI use in their company; 78% say reviews of AI projects are getting more laborious
42% have avoided non-EU products over data-protection concerns
Representative phone survey of 605 companies with 20+ staff, mid-2026; Bitkom lobbies for GDPR reform
take: Access to usable data, not models, is the brake: half of German companies say data protection slows their AI, and reviews are getting heavier.
title: Bitkom: data protection hinders AI at half of German firms
